video_title: Donovan Mitchell IS STILL the better player over Jalen Brunson after the Knicks BTA Cleveland 👀?

quotes.speaker: Raymond Felton
quotes.summary_phrase: Discussion about Kenny Atkinson's 'analytically won' comment
quotes.excerpt: What do you mean? How do you analytically win a game?

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: He said two out of the three games analytically we won.

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: They did.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: What do you mean? How do you analytically win a game?

text_blocks.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
text_blocks.text: That's what I'm saying. How do you analytically win a game?

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: We got to show the clip. That's the problem with analytics. That's the problem right there with analytics.

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: Yes, I get what you're saying.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: That's bad.

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: I get it. I get that you had to go to that and that's nasty to say in that moment. But if you sit here and you're a basketball player, you sit there like, bro, we just missed so many open shots.

text_blocks.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
text_blocks.text: But that's part of the game. Being able to shoot when it counts and when it matters.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: Analytically we won. What?

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: Analytically we won the game.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Coach hyping his team despite losses using analytics
quotes.excerpt: He's trying to hype his team up. He's giving them confidence, he's giving them faith that we can win.
quotes.quote: I know what he's doing. He was trying to hype his team up. He's giving them confidence, he's giving them faith that, yo, we can win, right? Because nobody has came back and won from a three-fucking-oh situation.

quotes.speaker: Raymond Felton
quotes.summary_phrase: Cleveland is mentally defeated by still thinking about Game 1 in Game 3
quotes.excerpt: It's Game 3 and you're still thinking about Game 1. I told you after Game 1 that they were fucked after that.
quotes.quote: It's Game 3 and you're still thinking about Game 1. I told you after Game 1 that they were fucked after that. Human nature, you're still thinking about that. It doesn't matter because even if you get a lead in Game 4, you're still like, oh fuck, are we going to do it again? Mentally, they're done. Donovan's hobbled.

quotes.speaker: Raymond Felton
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson is a superstar who makes big plays in crucial moments
quotes.excerpt: He made every single play that needed to be made, whether it was an assist or making a bucket.
quotes.quote: It was him. Nobody else. It was him. He made every single play that needed to be made, whether it was an assist or making a bucket. If it was LeBron, they would have been going crazy about LeBron. But because it's Jalen Brunson, it's not the same magnitude. We would have still been talking about it today. He deserves the respect. He's a superstar and he's... The fact that every single year for the past three years in a row, Conference Finals, Conference Finals and now Finals.

quotes.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
quotes.summary_phrase: Debating if Jalen Brunson is a top 10 player over Donovan Mitchell
quotes.excerpt: You guys were killing me for putting Jalen Brunson over Donovan Mitchell when I said Donovan Mitchell is not in my top 10.

text_blocks.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
text_blocks.text: I got to say something though. You guys were killing me for putting Jalen Brunson over Donovan Mitchell when I said Donovan Mitchell is not in my top 10.

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: What did I just talk about? The team. Their team is better than Cleveland.

text_blocks.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
text_blocks.text: My point is though, I still think Jalen Brunson is a top 10 over Donovan Mitchell. I'm just saying, it's not a crazy take. You guys thought I was crazy for that.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: No, no, no, don't point at me.

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: Jalen Brunson is not top 10 though.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: He's not.

text_blocks.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
text_blocks.text: You said Donovan Mitchell in the top 10. I said I had Jalen Brunson over him. I had Stephen Curry over him. You remember this conversation.

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: I would still keep Donovan Mitchell over Jalen Brunson in my opinion.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson is too comfortable against Cleveland, but will struggle against tougher defense
quotes.excerpt: He's too comfortable against Cleveland. Everything comes pretty easy.
quotes.quote: I would agree with you there because he's too comfortable against Cleveland, right? Everything comes pretty easy. San Antonio, Oklahoma is not going to play that shit. They're going to slow him down. They're going to make it difficult. They're going to bother him where he might struggle.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: The magnitude of a Knicks victory would require National Guard intervention in New York
quotes.excerpt: If New York wins, I don't think people understand the magnitude. They might have to call the National Guard for sure.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: If New York wins, I don't think people understand the magnitude.

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: They don't understand.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: They might have to call the National Guard for sure.

text_blocks.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
text_blocks.text: I've seen somebody say that. They said if they win, I'm not going out of my house for two weeks.

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: The city is going to be diabolical, fam.

text_blocks.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
text_blocks.text: I'm not going to lie to you guys, I've seen how crazy Toronto is. New York is going to be 50 times worse and that shit was nuts.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: They better if they win, they better win on the road.

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: It don't matter.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: Because if they win at home...

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: It don't matter.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: New York is going to be diabolical, fam.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: People destroy things after wins because they look for an excuse to act out
quotes.excerpt: What makes people when you win something, make you want to fuck up shit and destroy shit?

text_blocks.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
text_blocks.text: What makes people when you win something, make you want to fuck up shit and destroy shit?

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: No, it's because people, that's an excuse for them to act up. People got that shit built in them. People are the most dangerous fucking...

text_blocks.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
text_blocks.text: Go to a fucking, what's it, what's them rooms called?

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: Smash rooms.

text_blocks.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
text_blocks.text: Smash rooms. Go to one of them.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: People just look for an excuse to wild out, right?
